name: website_https
description: Ansible playbook that provisions Apache HTTPS on Ubuntu, including package installation, virtual-host configuration, self-signed TLS certificate generation, static content deployment, and service management.

name: poodle_fix
description: Ansible remediation playbook that hardens Apache SSL protocols to restrict legacy protocols and restarts affected services.

name: chef_platform_bootstrap
description: Bootstrap automation that deploys Chef Automate and Chef Infra Server, configures host and kernel settings, and provisions an initial Chef user and organization.

name: chef_server_bootstrap
description: Bootstrap automation for deploying Chef Infra Server, configuring host and kernel settings, and creating the initial Chef user and organization.

name: ssh_profile
description: Chef InSpec compliance profile that verifies SSH root login is disabled and performs a fallback OpenSSH package assertion.

name: website_https_verify
description: Chef InSpec verification profile that checks HTTPS availability, expected site content, and TLS protocol configuration.
